color_protocol.rule: Always BLUE before GREEN or RED. Never act blindly.

R1_core_file_conflict.action: Verify data against code. If mismatch → ask user before continuing.

R2_branch_control.action: Warn user. Define project branch once. All work on that branch. Push to main only on explicit request.

R4_new_env_variable.action: Check if exists. If not → add to code, register in config.json, notify user.

steps: 2. Deprecate old + create new in parallel

R7_outdated_module.action: Update module in library immediately upon detecting divergence.

R8_minimum_tests.node_complete_condition: Node marked COMPLETE only when minimum tests pass.

R9_service_down.action: Stop full operation. Register DOWN with timestamp. Queue in pending_sync.json. Await REINTENTAR.

R16_architectural_coherence.action: When adding feature or modifying architecture → load decisions.json → verify proposal doesn't contradict any ACTIVE or SETTLED decision.

R17_ddd_domain_isolation.action: Every business rule lives in a unique domain directory. Inter-domain communication async only (event-driven or abstract connector). No cross-domain DB/memory access.

R18_agent_loop_safety.action: Every iterative loop declares explicit max_iterations counter and structured escape routing. Recursive generation/testing loops run in isolated git worktree or sandbox.

R19_zero_direct_env.action: No sub-agent or skill invokes process.env or reads raw config. Secrets injected at runtime via Secure Key Broker, only in infrastructure/connector layer.

R20_core_file_protection.action: If modifying core framework file → do not break existing abstraction. Extend via DI or composition. When creating new module → inspect architect-ai-modules/templates and replicate skeleton and types exactly.

layer_3_session_end.method: fs.writeFile all → git add __AI_CORE__/ → git commit → git push origin [project_branch]

session_commands.INICIAR PROYECTO: Create __AI_CORE__ structure from scratch with initial agreement
session_commands.CERRAR SESIÓN: Close protocol, SNAP FINAL and save
session_commands.INSTALAR MÓDULO: Download module from library to project

steps: 0. Read selective fields from __AI_CORE__/ per CLAUDE.md Step 0
1. Read config.json → extract project, current_node, progress_pct
3. Calculate health.json → alert if debt exceeds threshold
6. If patterns.json has active patterns → apply reinforced checks

multi_agent_protocol.activation: Automatic on subagent detection. Single agent = default mode.
rules: No agent pushes to main without Architect approval

bounded_context_subagents.principle: Within each domain, atomic hyper-specific role sub-agents are assigned. A sub-agent cannot escape its bounded context.

atomic_roles.domain_validator: Validates business rules and domain invariants
atomic_roles.connector_adapter: Mediates with infrastructure only via connectors + Secure Key Broker

constraints: Sub-agent operates only within its domain
No access to another domain's memory or DB
No process.env — uses Secure Key Broker
